caption: A clear plastic ruler is laid over a line of text, and the text is readable through the ruler.

sa.check: A plastic ruler is laid over a line of text.
The text is readable through the ruler.

pc.expect: The letters are seen through the plastic and the ruler does not hide them.
pc.fail: The ruler hides the text; or it shows different text; or the text is heavily warped by a flat ruler.

pc.expect: The text is unchanged; any shift is at the ruler's edges only.
pc.fail: The text changes; or letters move under the ruler; or the text is mirrored.

pc.expect: The ruler and the page stay put unless moved.
pc.fail: The ruler slides by itself; or the page moves; or the text shifts with both still.

pc.expect: The ruler is rigid and clear.
pc.fail: It bends; or goes opaque; or ripples.
The ruler duplicates; or the page vanishes; or the ruler passes through the page.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The page and the ruler's markings stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes colour; or the markings change; or the desk changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
